name: video-editor
description: A desktop video editor whose chrome stays dark and quiet so the frame is the only lit thing on screen.

scripts.dev:electron: node scripts/electron-pkg.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && wait-on dist-electron/electron/main.js http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON=1 VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.check: node scripts/check-contract.mjs && node scripts/check-timeline-guards.mjs && node scripts/check-linking.mjs && node scripts/check-fps-snap.mjs && node scripts/check-export-graph.mjs && node scripts/check-release.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run icon && npm run stage:ffmpeg && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:nobundle: npm run build && npm run icon && node scripts/stage-ffmpeg.mjs --skip && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
